core_meaning.primary_meaning: Zaleha is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Righteous, virtuous”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Zaleha corresponds to the Arabic form صَالِحَة (Arabic root ص ل ح (ṣ-l-ḥ); صَالِحَة (Ṣāliḥa)). Its core sense is zaleha; righteous, virtuous (feminine) (malay form). Zaleha is the Malay form of Arabic صَالِحَة (Ṣāliḥa), the feminine of صَالِح, meaning 'righteous, virtuous'.
